rules.classification_note: CHANGED from A. Checker workflow dispute: the storage facts (per-origin, eviction, private-mode clearing, Safari 7-day deletion) are A, but the conclusion that shared state cannot live there and the 'saved on this device only' labelling policy rest on inference no source states.
rules.evidence: OBSERVED: the page writes nothing to storage today ("writes": [], "localStorageKeys": []). SOURCES: MDN says localStorage is specific to the document's origin and protocol (http vs https are different stores), persists across sessions, is cleared when the last private tab closes, and can throw SecurityError when storage is blocked. MDN Storage quotas says data is managed per origin, is best-effort by default (evicted LRU under storage pressure unless persisted), Web Storage is limited to 5 MiB local plus 5 MiB session per origin, and Safari deletes script-created data after 7 days of browser use with no interaction when tracking prevention is on. WHATWG says 'Each site has its own separate storage area' and user agents 'may ... automatically delete stored data after a period of time'. None of the sources mentions cross-device sync; that localStorage is tied to one browser profile on one device is my inference from per-origin, per-user-agent storage.
rules.limitations: navigator.storage.persist() reduces eviction but still does not share data.
rules.configurable: No.
rules.missing_data_blocks: If storage throws or comes back empty, the page must still render every exception as unacknowledged. It must never hide rows because of missing local state.
rules.recommendation: For the demo, keep acknowledgements in a committed data/acknowledgements.csv (append-only: exception_id, ack_by, ack_at, note, owner, shelved_until), read like the other CSVs. Mark any browser-only notes clearly. Wrap every storage call in try/catch.
rules.phase_note: Phase-2 default: per-device conveniences only (filter, last review time), every storage call wrapped in try/catch, and the page renders fully with an empty store.

SecurityError is thrown when the 'request violates a policy decision' (e.g. persistence blocked). The page does not mention cross-device sync, as the research disclosed.

sources.title: Storage quotas and eviction criteria
sources.supports: Per-origin; best-effort vs persistent; LRU eviction; 5 MiB limits; Safari 7-day eviction
sources.checker_note: Used in rule 15 and the persist integration. The page reads 'last modified on Jan 5, 2026', which matches. 'In most cases, browsers manage stored data per origin.' It defines best-effort (the default) and persistent storage, and LRU eviction ('The data from the least recently used origin is deleted'). Verbatim: 'Browsers can store up to 5 MiB of local storage, and 5 MiB of session storage per origin' (also 'limited to 10 MiB of data maximum'). Safari: 'If an origin has no user interaction... in the last seven days of browser use, its data created from script will be deleted' when cross-site tracking prevention is on. persist(): Firefox shows a prompt, while Safari and Chromium auto-approve or deny, which supports 'browser may prompt or decide'. When used as the evidence_url for last_review_at, it supports only per-device storage. Calling localStorage 'acceptable' for conveniences is the researcher's judgement.

sources.checker_note: I fetched it three times. Every quoted claim was found. Sec 4.4 (pp.46-47): 'To establish immunity, almost all products recommend a second vaccination two (2) to four (4) weeks after the initial vaccination.' p.42 (also p.11): 'Follow all FDA/USDA/EPA guidelines and label directions for each product.' Sec 6.2 (pp.14-15) lists the individual record items, and group treatments record 'Group or lot identification' plus the same items. p.15: 'Keep records for a minimum of two years or longer as required by laws/regulations'. Ch.2 Temperature Conditions (pp.26-27): 'work them before the temperature humidity index (THI) reaches 84', 'Avoid handling cattle when the risk of heat stress is high', and 'Work cattle more prone to heat stress first, earlier in the day'. p.48: 'A VCPR cannot exist based solely on phone, video, or other telemedical interactions.' p.45: vaccines 'have either a 21 or 60 day withdrawal time'. p.42: VFD records are kept two years. Sec 4.5 (titled 'Judicious Use of Antimicrobials', not VCPR): protocols 'define when to quit treating and seek professional help'. Its newest data are the 2016 NBQA, a 2018 'Unpublished' footnote and data for '1998 to 2017', which points to an edition from about 2019. NCBA announced an updated manual on 2024-12-19. The research's 2025-01-06 date is that of the trade-press reprints. bqa.org/resources/manuals now links bqa-national-manual-2026.pdf and does NOT link bqa_manual_final.pdf. The cited file is therefore very likely a superseded edition. My two fetches of the 2026 manual both failed with CLIENT_ERROR, so I could not confirm that the 2-4 week, THI 84, record-item, retention and VCPR wording is still in the current edition.

rules.evidence: OBSERVED: "mediaPrintRules": 0, "pageRules": 0, "printColorAdjust": "economy". The Chromium default PDF (backgrounds off) ran to "pdfPages": 4 on Letter. Measured at 300 dpi, the main text colour (--ink: title, tile values, Area, What, Problem, severity words) printed rgb(158,157,154), 2.71:1 on white. First step (--ink-2) printed rgb(112,111,106), 5.03:1. The faint notes and table headers (--muted) printed rgb(59,58,55), 11.37:1. So the print hierarchy is inverted: the most important text is the faintest. At 150 dpi the gain chart's target lines and 'target 1.0/2.0' labels are near-white on white and practically invisible, the budget legend swatches (CSS backgrounds) are gone, and card shadows print as grey bands. SOURCES: MDN Printing (@media print, @page, beforeprint/afterprint). MDN print-color-adjust says that by default (economy) a browser 'might opt to leave out all background images and to adjust text colors'. The Penn State SOP Writing Guide says to post SOPs at the workplace in text large enough to read while working, laminate them, use pictures because they help regardless of literacy or native language, and write short imperative sentences. Cornell (Skellie 2019) says to post procedures in plain view, keep grouped protocols in a binder, and translate if needed.
evidence_corrections: Skellie (Cornell 2019) does not say 'frequently used' procedures, and the Stup (Penn State) guide has no translation advice; translation comes from Skellie.
rules.limitations: Print output was measured only in headless Chromium's PDF. Firefox and Safari were not tested and may differ. The extension SOP guidance is dairy-oriented (Penn State, Cornell), and I found no Northern Plains ranch-specific crew-briefing source (web search was unavailable).

rules.rule: PROPOSED design target (not validated): a ~2-minute morning review. Freshness line, then counts ('2 today / 6 this week / 2 plan', 'N new since last review, M resolved'), then the exception list with Open-for and Owner, with charts below as drill-down only.

rules.evidence: OBSERVED: today's report has 10 rows and 215 words in the row cells (rowCount 10, wordsInRows 215), plus 5 tiles. The tiles mix status ('Head on grass 375') with exceptions. SOURCES (by analogy only): Drew et al. 2014 (PLOS ONE) observed 2,558,760 alarms over 31 days in 77 ICU beds (187 audible alarms per bed per day), with 88.8% of 12,671 annotated arrhythmia alarms false positives. The authors recommend tailoring alarm settings and making delays configurable. exida (consultancy white paper) ISA-18.2 benchmarks put about 150 alarms/day per operator as 'very likely acceptable' and 300 as the maximum manageable, for a continuously staffed console. The alarm definition ends '...abnormal condition requiring a response.' MISQUOTE: the research quotes 'If the operator does not need to respond, there should be no alarm.' The paper says 'This means if the operator does not need to respond, then there should not be an alarm.' Priority: 'Alarm priority should be set based on the severity of the consequences and the time to respond'; 'no more than three or four different alarm priorities'; '3 priorities: ~80% Low, ~15% Medium, ~5% High'. Table 1 is 'Based upon at least 30 days of data', with ~150/day 'Very Likely to be Acceptable' and ~300/day 'Maximum Manageable' (~1 and ~2 per 10 min). Stale Alarms: 'Less than 5 present on any day, with action plans to address.' The 10 lifecycle stages include MOC and Audit.

data_fields.meaning: The moment the data snapshot represents. Every 'today', 'overdue', 'silent', 'days in pasture' and 'closed month' judgement is measured from it.
data_fields.units_valid: Current value '2026-09-30T18:00' has no UTC offset, so browsers read it as viewer-local time. Phase 1: ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-09-30T18:00-05:00), or a bare local time interpreted in meta.timezone.

data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Reject a value that does not parse. Without an offset or meta.timezone, show 'data time unknown', drop 'today' wording and treat time-based rules as CAN'T TELL. Rows dated after as_of are excluded from rules and counted as data issues.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (workflow): MDN localStorage has nothing on timestamps, offsets or time zones. The rationale (JavaScript parses an offset-less date-time as viewer-local time) is an observation; cite MDN Date.parse or ECMA-262 if a source is wanted. Evidence URL removed. Checker (budget): GFOA says nothing about timestamps or time zones. No supporting source after checker review (MDN localStorage and GFOA were rejected for this field). The problem itself was observed in the repository.

data_fields.units_valid: Integer days > 0. State technical notes give ranges by growth period and use level (for example NDSU R1780 and SD TN9).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Rest check (phase 2) shows 'no rest target set' for that pasture.

data_fields.meaning: Management group name (demo: Cows, Heifers, Yearlings).
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Primary key. Referenced by moves.group, weights.group and health.group.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Changes when groups are formed or sold.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: A row elsewhere naming an unknown group is a data issue shown on the page, not silently dropped.

data_fields.meaning: Animal class (demo: cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers). Drives wording now and intake lookups later.
data_fields.units_valid: Text; later a controlled list matching the intake table classes.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Shown as 'class not recorded'; class-based lookups are skipped (CAN'T TELL).

data_fields.meaning: Current head count in the group.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: On any move, sale, death or purchase.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Coverage cannot be computed, so the group gain verdict is withheld (CAN'T TELL).
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (gain): the Data.gov CPER dataset page does not support the groups.head field. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.meaning: The ADG the group is judged against (demo: Yearlings 2.0, Heifers 1.0, Cows 0.0 = not judged).
data_fields.units_valid: lb/day >= 0. 0 means the gain rules skip the group; the page must say so (RULE-GAIN-05). Demo values are demo settings.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or non-numeric: the group is CAN'T TELL for gain, never silently skipped.

data_fields.meaning: Group that made the stay.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown group: data issue row.

data_fields.meaning: Pasture of the stay.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown pasture: data issue (CAN'T TELL), not a grazing alarm.

data_fields.meaning: Day the group entered the pasture.
data_fields.units_valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or before as_of.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank, invalid or after as_of: data issue; the stay is not judged.

data_fields.meaning: Day the group left; blank means the stay is open.
data_fields.units_valid: ISO date, on or after in_date; blank = open stay.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: At most one open stay per group; two or more is a data issue.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: out_date before in_date, or a group with more than one open stay: data issue (CAN'T TELL), not a grazing alarm.

data_fields.meaning: Tank the reading came from (demo T1-T8).
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Must exist in tanks.csv (phase-1 master list). A tank in tanks.csv with no readings is CAN'T TELL, not absent.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown tank_id: data issue.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (water): the NRCS 614 citation has no bearing on this field. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.meaning: Pasture the tank serves, repeated on each reading.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Must agree with tanks.csv pasture_id for that tank; a mismatch is a data issue. tanks.csv becomes the authority.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Mismatch or unknown: data issue; the tank keeps its tanks.csv pasture.

data_fields.meaning: Time of the reading.
data_fields.units_valid: Current values have no UTC offset. Phase 1: ISO 8601 with offset, or local time read in meta.timezone.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Per (tank_id, time); duplicates are a data issue.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Per reading (demo every 6 h; vendors 4/day satellite to 24/day cellular).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Unparseable: reading rejected. Readings after as_of are excluded. Silence is measured from as_of.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (water): the Ranchbot Delay page supports irregular reporting and staleness; the time-zone requirement comes from the repo audit, not this page.

data_fields.meaning: Tank level as percent full.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank, non-numeric or outside 0-100: not a reading (never treated as 0); counted as a data issue.

data_fields.meaning: Animal identifier.
data_fields.units_valid: String, unique per animal; never reused.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: One animal belongs to one group per weigh-in; the same tag twice on one date is a data issue.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Row rejected and counted in a data-issues line.
data_fields.evidence_url: https://docs.c-lockinc.com/Document - Beef Improvement Federation Guidelines for FE Testing.pdf
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (gain): the BIF guidelines (vendor-hosted copy) support per-animal pairing only indirectly and say nothing about tag uniqueness.

data_fields.meaning: Group at the weigh-in.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Row excluded from group figures and reported as a data issue.

data_fields.units_valid: ISO date, on or before as_of.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: (group, date) identifies the weigh session (see weigh_sessions.csv).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Row rejected; dates after as_of are excluded.

data_fields.meaning: Live weight.
data_fields.units_valid: lb, number > 0; plausible range per class (for example 300-1,000 yearlings); no thousands separators.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or implausible: excluded and listed as a data issue, never coerced to 0.

data_fields.meaning: Group the scheduled task applies to.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Show a 'group not recorded' data-issue row.

data_fields.meaning: Schedule label (demo: Booster vaccine, Pinkeye check, Deworm, ...).
data_fields.units_valid: Text; a schedule label only, never a finding, diagnosis or treatment instruction. Rendered as text.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: (group, task) identifies a schedule row today; a task_id is added later.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank: data issue row.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (health): 21 CFR 530.3 defines the VCPR; it does not address task labels. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.meaning: Date the task was last completed.
data_fields.units_valid: ISO date, on or before as_of; blank allowed for a task never done.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Per schedule row. Later, completions go to an append-only history (RULE-WF-16).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank is allowed; an invalid date is a data issue.

data_fields.meaning: Planned date for the task (demo: Yearlings booster 2026-09-15, Cows pinkeye check 2026-10-03).
data_fields.units_valid: ISO date. Blank is allowed only on done or cancelled rows.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank on an open task: show a 'No due date recorded' data-issue row (today it is skipped silently).

data_fields.meaning: Task state.
data_fields.units_valid: open | done | cancelled | deferred, compared after trimming and lower-casing.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Any other value is a data-issue row (today it is dropped silently).
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (health): the BQA manual does not address task status vocabularies. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.meaning: Budget month (demo 2026-06 to 2026-09).
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: (month, category) unique; a duplicate pair is a data issue.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Invalid month: row rejected with a data-quality message. Months after meta.books_closed_through count as plan only, not as season-to-date.

data_fields.meaning: Spending category (demo: Feed and mineral, Fuel, Labor, Repairs, Vet and health, Water and fencing).
data_fields.units_valid: Controlled list; later mapped to ERS cost items (RULE-BUD-12).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank: row rejected. An unmapped category is still monitored.

data_fields.meaning: Planned spend for that category and month (the phased plan).
data_fields.units_valid: USD >= 0; plain digits with optional decimal (no '$', no thousands separators, no '(300)').
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Set before the season; monthly columns.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank = 'no budget entered' data issue (not 0). An explicit 0 goes to the unbudgeted-spend rule in dollars (RULE-BUD-06).
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (budget): UNL CropWatch supports monthly phasing only; the number-format and blank-versus-0 rules are the data contract's, not the source's.

data_fields.meaning: Actual spend for that category and month.
data_fields.units_valid: USD, signed number (credits allowed later via entry_type).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank in a closed month = 'actual not entered' row; no severity for that category. Never treated as $0.

data_fields.meaning: The ranch's IANA time zone, used to read local times and to display as_of.
data_fields.units_valid: IANA name, for example America/Chicago or America/Denver.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: One value for the whole snapshot.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: If as_of carries an offset, use it and show the offset; otherwise show 'time zone not set' and treat time-based rules as CAN'T TELL.
data_fields.evidence_note: A data-contract decision (lead phase-1 default); no external source needed.

data_fields.meaning: Last month whose actuals are complete.
data_fields.units_valid: YYYY-MM, not after the month of as_of.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Default to the month before as_of's month and label it 'assumed closed through'.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (budget): GFOA 'Budget monitoring' says nothing about books-closed months or data completeness. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.meaning: Every tank the ranch expects to hear from, so a tank with no readings is visible.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Primary key; water.tank_id must exist here.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: If tanks.csv is missing, fall back to tanks seen in water.csv and show 'tank list not provided'.

data_fields.meaning: Pasture the tank serves.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Foreign key to pastures.csv; one tank per pasture in the demo, several allowed.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown pasture: data issue.

data_fields.meaning: Display name.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Show tank_id.

data_fields.meaning: Whether the tank is in use (a tank drained for winter is out of service).
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Rare; record who changed it later (RULE-WF-19).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Treat as in service. An out-of-service tank is shown as 'out of service' and not judged; it is never hidden.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports suppressing out-of-service plant; the changed_by/at/reason audit fields are the researcher's design.

data_fields.meaning: How the weights in a session were taken, so ADG compares like with like.
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: One row per (group, date) in weights.csv.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Basis unknown or different between the two sessions: ADG shown as provisional, with no serious or individual flags (CAN'T TELL). The demo must record a basis for every session so the planted gain problems still show.

data_fields.meaning: Level below which a tank is critical (demo 25%).
data_fields.units_valid: Percent 0-100; label 'Demo setting (D)' or 'Ranch choice' in the rules table.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Not configured: show levels without severity and say 'threshold not set'.

data_fields.meaning: Level below which a tank is a warning (demo 40%).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: As waterCritical.

data_fields.meaning: Fall in points over a bounded window that counts as an unexplained fall (demo 30 points in 24 h).
data_fields.units_valid: Points 0-100; window in hours with a tolerance of one reporting interval.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: As waterCritical.

data_fields.meaning: Hours without a reading, measured from as_of, before a tank is CAN'T TELL (demo 24 h).
data_fields.units_valid: Hours > 0; later per device from expected_report_interval_h.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Use 24 h and label it an assumption.

data_fields.meaning: Days before a planned move date that raise a warning (demo 2).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: No move-reminder warning.

data_fields.meaning: Share of the group target below which group gain is serious (demo 0.8).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Show ADG without verdict.

data_fields.meaning: Share of the group target below which an individual is listed (demo 0.5).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: No individual list.

data_fields.field: gain minimum interval and minimum coverage (new)
data_fields.meaning: Shortest weigh interval (or number of weights) before ADG is judged, and the share of the group that must be weighed in both sessions.
data_fields.units_valid: Days > 0 (research default for individuals about 70 d or 3+ weights); coverage fraction 0-1. Values must be chosen and tested so the demo's planted gain problems are still found.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Gain verdicts shown as provisional (CAN'T TELL).

data_fields.meaning: Days ahead that an open health task becomes a warning (demo 7).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: No due-soon warning.

data_fields.field: budget thresholds (budgetWarn, budgetSerious, warnUsd, seriousUsd, largeUsd, unbudgetedUsd)
data_fields.meaning: Percent and dollar materiality for budget rows. Current: budgetWarn 0.05, budgetSerious 0.10. Phase-1 demo values: warn 5% and $500, serious 10% and $1,000, large $2,500, unbudgeted $250.
data_fields.units_valid: Fractions 0-1 and USD >= 0; inclusive comparisons; every value labelled 'Demo setting'.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Once a season or after review.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Show variances with no severity and a 'thresholds not set' note.

data_fields.meaning: Why each threshold exists: 'Demo setting (D)' until sourced or set by the ranch, then 'Ranch choice, set by <name>, <date>'.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Label the threshold 'Demo setting (unvalidated)'.
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports alarm change control and audits; the change-log schema is the researcher's design.

data_fields.meaning: Usable capacity, and the geometry that converts level to gallons Also: Tank volume and how it refills
data_fields.units_valid: gal > 0; shape in {vertical cylinder, horizontal cylinder, elliptical, rectangular}; ft
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: once, and on any tank change
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal > 0; shape in {vertical cylinder, horizontal cylinder, elliptical, rectangular}; ft. Missing or invalid: Do not compute hours. Show 'capacity unknown'. Severity falls back to the labelled demo % rule.

data_fields.meaning: Float-fed drinking tank vs storage tank vs hauled-water tank vs pond/dugout
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum {float_fed, storage, hauled, surface}. Missing or invalid: Do not apply leak or drawdown logic. Show the fall without interpretation.

data_fields.meaning: Water source (electric well, solar, windmill, pipeline, rural water, hauled) and measured inflow Also: Tank volume and how it refills
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: once a season or after repair (Bartlett: test well yield and drawdown with a driller, because summer use rises)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum; gpm ≥0. Missing or invalid: Hours-of-water shown with zero inflow only, labelled worst case

data_fields.meaning: Distance between the sensor and the usable bottom (mud, outlet height)
data_fields.units_valid: inches, ±240 per Ranchbot (vendor) input validation; datetime
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches, ±240 per Ranchbot (vendor) input validation; datetime. Missing or invalid: Flag readings as 'offset unknown' near thresholds

data_fields.meaning: How often this device should report
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: hours > 0. Missing or invalid: Use the fixed 24 h silence limit, labelled an assumption

data_fields.field: out_of_service audit (changed_by, changed_at, reason), tank_shutoff, planned_move_in
data_fields.meaning: Asset deliberately excluded from rules, e.g. a tank drained for winter Also: A float deliberately off in a resting pasture, and the next use
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: boolean plus audit fields. Missing or invalid: Treat as in service
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports suppressing out-of-service plant; the changed_by/at/reason audit fields are the researcher's design.

data_fields.meaning: Alternative source and gallons per haul
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text; gal. Missing or invalid: Action text cannot name a backup

data_fields.meaning: Measured water height above the sensor, before offset
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches, ≥0. Missing or invalid: Use level_pct and mark it uncalibrated

data_fields.meaning: Vendor status (OK, Delay, No Data, Error, Error High, Error Low)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum per vendor. Missing or invalid: Infer only 'silent' from the timestamps

data_fields.meaning: Monitor battery voltage
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: V (vendor: 6.6-7.2 healthy, <6.5 likely failing). Missing or invalid: Cause of silence reported as unknown
data_fields.evidence_note: Voltage bands are vendor statements (Farmbot), model-specific.

data_fields.meaning: Metered inflow per day
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal/day ≥0. Missing or invalid: No overflow or stuck-open detection; say so
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (water): NRCS Missouri 'Watering Systems for Serious Graziers' never mentions flow or water meters. Evidence URL removed.

data_fields.field: checked_at, checked_by, result (ok / low / dirty / float-fault / leak / dry), float_ok, overflow, ice, notes
data_fields.meaning: In-person observation Also: Eyes-on confirmation of tank function and cleanliness
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Keyed by tank_id and time; tank_id must exist in tanks.csv.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: datetime; booleans; free text. Missing or invalid: Show 'not checked by eye since <date>'
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (workflow): 'daily' appears only in a BQA sample protocol template; the assessment itself does not require daily checks. Checker (water): the NDSU 2007 release supports only more frequent checks in heat, not the log's structure.

data_fields.field: source_id, date, method (meter/strip/lab), tds_ppm, sulfate_ppm, nitrate_ppm (state NO3 or NO3-N)
data_fields.meaning: Screening and lab results
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: source_id = tank_id or a named pond/well.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: per test (in drought, for new or surface sources)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ppm (mg/L); method enum. Missing or invalid: Show 'not screened'; never 'OK'

data_fields.field: algae observation (source_id, date, status none/suspect/bloom, photo, sample_sent, vet_contacted)
data_fields.meaning: Cyanobacteria watch on surface water
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: source_id = tank_id or a named pond.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: weekly or more in late summer heat (ranch choice)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum; booleans. Missing or invalid: Show 'not observed'

data_fields.meaning: Time to reach the tank, and the next scheduled pass
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: hours; datetime. Missing or invalid: Use a ranch default and label it

data_fields.field: head present by class per pasture
data_fields.meaning: Animals drinking at this tank now
data_fields.units_valid: integer head; class in {cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers, ...}
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Open stays in moves.csv joined to groups.csv; a pasture with an unknown group is CAN'T TELL.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer head; class in {cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers, ...}. Missing or invalid: Treat the tank as possibly in use. Do not downgrade severity.

data_fields.field: water status of the occupied and destination pasture
data_fields.meaning: Latest tank level and sensor freshness, already computed by waterStatus()
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: tanks.pasture_id joined to the group's open stay and planned_next_pasture.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: % full; hours since last reading. Missing or invalid: Silent sensor gives 'water unknown: check by eye before moving'

data_fields.meaning: Inputs to intake lookup Also: Calving date and whether the animal is nursing
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Per group (or per animal for calving dates).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb; enum {dry, lactating, growing}. Missing or invalid: Use the class default and label the assumption

data_fields.meaning: Reference daily intake by class, weight and temperature Also: Estimated daily intake by class, weight and temperature
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Rows by class; columns by temperature band (40-90F).
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal/head/day; table rows 40-90F. Missing or invalid: Use the highest value in the class's row and label it an assumed hot-day figure (for lactating cows in AS1763 that is 80F, 17.9 gal)
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker: the 90F column is not the most conservative for lactating cows (AS1763: 17.9 gal at 80F vs 16.2 at 90F).

data_fields.field: daily_high_f and hourly forecast (temp_f, rh_pct, wind_mph, sky_cover_pct), forecast THI
data_fields.meaning: NWS gridpoint hourly forecast for the location Also: Temperature driving intake / Temperature-humidity index computed from hourly forecast temperature and RH or dewpoint for the ranch location
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Keyed by forecast point and hour; pinned to as_of in the demo.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Not stated on the cited documentation page; record retrieved_at on each snapshot
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: F, %, mph, %. Missing or invalid: No heat/cold panel; never default to 'Normal'
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (health): weather.gov documentation states no forecast update frequency; 'several times daily' is unsupported.

data_fields.meaning: ARS breathing-rate category from the forecast
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Normal <90, Alert 90-110, Danger 110-130, Emergency >130 breaths/min. Missing or invalid: Hide

data_fields.meaning: Comprehensive Climate Index apparent temperature
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: degrees F; NDAWN bands. Missing or invalid: Hide

data_fields.meaning: Planned move-out date for this stay (replaces the per-pasture planned_graze_days as the plan of record)
data_fields.units_valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or after in_date
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: When the plan is written or revised
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or after in_date. Missing or invalid: Fall back to in_date + pasture planned_graze_days and label it 'default plan'

data_fields.meaning: Destination pasture for the next move
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: pasture_id in pastures.csv. Missing or invalid: Show 'destination not planned'; skip the destination readiness check (do not report ready)
data_fields.evidence_note: Checker (grazing): CPS 528 supports only the general water and monitoring criteria; its link to this field is loose.

data_fields.meaning: Head count and average weight (or AUE) of the group on this stay
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer head > 0; lb (or AUE 0.5-1.5). Missing or invalid: Use groups.csv head and a class-default AUE labelled as an assumption

data_fields.meaning: Recorded reason for an intentional deviation (early re-entry, combined herds, dormant-season use, targeted grazing, drought)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: free text or enumerated code. Missing or invalid: The deviation is reported as a warning

data_fields.meaning: Recovery minimum before re-grazing during fast (vegetative, pre-boot) and slow (boot onward) growth
data_fields.units_valid: integer days, roughly 25-90; defaults from the state NRCS FOTG (e.g. SD TN9 West River range 40/60 at 20-30% use; NDSU western ND range 45/65)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer days, roughly 25-90; defaults from the state NRCS FOTG (e.g. SD TN9 West River range 40/60 at 20-30% use; NDSU western ND range 45/65). Missing or invalid: Use the existing single min_rest_days and label it 'not growth-adjusted'

data_fields.meaning: Window in which rest counts as recovery
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: month-day. Missing or invalid: Count all calendar days and label the rest figure 'calendar days'

data_fields.meaning: Species monitored in the pasture's key area and its minimum residual height at end of grazing
data_fields.units_valid: species name; inches (e.g. western wheatgrass 4, big bluestem 6, Kentucky bluegrass 2 per SD TN9 Table 3)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: species name; inches (e.g. western wheatgrass 4, big bluestem 6, Kentucky bluegrass 2 per SD TN9 Table 3). Missing or invalid: Stubble rule disabled for the pasture; show 'no target set'

data_fields.meaning: Forage available for planning graze days
data_fields.units_valid: lb/ac air-dry; harvest efficiency 0.125-0.40 (NDSU: 25% season-long native, 30% tame)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb/ac air-dry; harvest efficiency 0.125-0.40 (NDSU: 25% season-long native, 30% tame). Missing or invalid: Label planned days 'manager plan, not forage-derived'

data_fields.field: date, pasture_id, observer, residual_in or utilization_pct, recovery_ready, photo_point
data_fields.meaning: Field check of residual and regrowth
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: pasture_id must exist in pastures.csv; link to the stay by pasture and date.
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches or %; yes/no/unsure; text. Missing or invalid: 'Recovery not checked' before planned move-in

data_fields.meaning: Mean grazed height of the key species in the key area
data_fields.units_valid: inches >= 0; n_readings integer (NDSU suggests at least 30 per key species)
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Before entry, about weekly during occupancy, within 3 days of exit
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches >= 0; n_readings integer (NDSU suggests at least 30 per key species). Missing or invalid: Stale-observation warning; never 'OK'

data_fields.meaning: Percent of current-year growth removed by weight
data_fields.id_relationship_rules: Per pasture_id and stay or season.
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: End of each stay (temporal); end of season (seasonal)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-100; method in {grazing-stick height-weight, ocular, paired-plot}. Missing or invalid: Do not report compliance with take-half-leave-half

data_fields.meaning: Phenology of the key species (vegetative/pre-boot = fast; boot, heading, seed = slow; dormant)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum. Missing or invalid: Use a month proxy (May/Jun fast, Jul/Aug slow) labelled as an assumption

data_fields.meaning: Quick ranch-defined condition/readiness score for the pasture. NRCS's 10-indicator 1-5 Pasture Condition Score is framed around improved (tame) pastures; that it does not apply to rangeland is an inference, not stated in the guide.
data_fields.units_valid: ordinal 1-5 (ranch rubric) or NRCS PCS total for tame pasture
data_fields.timestamp_and_frequency: Before grazing (NRCS PCS: best just before a pasture is grazed) and at critical periods
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ordinal 1-5 (ranch rubric) or NRCS PCS total for tame pasture. Missing or invalid: Not shown

data_fields.meaning: Herd behaviour that signals forage shortfall (walking fence, bunching at gate/water, selecting less-preferred plants)
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum + free text. Missing or invalid: Treat as unknown, not normal
data_fields.evidence_url: https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/51815/67. 2020 REM - CARM - adaptive multipaddock rotational grazing - vegetation and livestock responses.pdf

data_fields.meaning: RAP annual herbaceous production, weighted mean over the pasture polygon Also: Modelled herbaceous production per pasture polygon (annual; 16-day provisional for current year)
data_fields.units_valid: lbs/acre; years 1986 to the previous year
data_fields.validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lbs/acre; years 1986 to the previous year. Missing or invalid: No polygon: omit; no county substitute

data_fields.meaning: NRCS ecological site and its reference production

integrations.name: NWS API (api.weather.gov)
integrations.provides: Point-to-grid lookup; 7-day 12-hour and hourly forecasts on about a 2.5 km grid; gridded data; alerts; station observations.
integrations.access: HTTPS GET, GeoJSON default; 'A User Agent is required'; no key now, 'will be replaced with an API key in the future'
integrations.licensing: 'intended to be open data, free to use for any purpose'
integrations.refresh: Forecasts updated by forecast offices; cadence not stated on the documentation page.
integrations.latency: Observations may be delayed up to 20 minutes (documentation). Forecast issuance lag not stated.
integrations.failure_behavior: Rate-limit errors, retry after ~5 s. Outages announced via NCEP admin messages. The API host was robots-blocked to WebFetch; CORS and browser User-Agent handling UNVERIFIED
integrations.browser_cors_or_key_issues: A User-Agent header identifying the application is required, and an API key is planned. Browsers may not let page scripts set User-Agent; CORS and browser handling were not verified (the API host was robots-blocked to the research tool). Fetch at build time (for example a scheduled GitHub Action writing a dated CSV with provenance) so browser CORS and keys never reach the page; the test workflow stays offline.
integrations.recommendation: Defer (live integrations are deferred). If a heat panel is built (RULE-CTX-07), take a dated build-time snapshot; never call it live from the static demo, because a live forecast does not match the fictional as_of.
integrations.verification_note: [cite_context.json checked[27], claim yes] Page says 'A User Agent is required to identify your application', which 'will be replaced with an API key in the future'. The API is 'intended to be open data, free to use for any purpose'. Rate-limited requests 'may be retried after the limit clears (typically within 5 seconds)'. forecastHourly covers 'the next seven days'. 'Observations may be delayed up to 20 minutes'. Known Issues 'Updated 3/24/2026'. CORS is not mentioned. The '~2.5 km grids' claim was not confirmed in this fetch. || [cite_water.json checked[43], claim yes] Confirmed: 'open data, free to use for any purpose'; 'A User Agent is required'; the /points endpoint; 'about 2.5km x 2.5km'; caching the grid; retry 'typically within 5 seconds'; observations 'delayed up to 20 minutes'; gridX/gridY 'may occasionally change'. Small mislabel: the 'Known Issues' section says 'No significant known issues'. The null 24h max/min 'for stations outside the central time zone' is listed under Upstream Issues/Changes as a MADIS ingest bug, and it affects station observations endpoints, not forecasts. || [cite_health.json checked[29], claim partly] These integration claims are supported verbatim: 'intended to be open data, free to use for any purpose'; 'A User Agent is required to identify your application'; it 'will be replaced with an API key in the future'; 'The rate limit is not public information', retry 'typically within 5 seconds'; 'cache-friendly approach'; /points/{lat},{lon} gives forecastHourly and forecastGridData over seven days; gridX/gridY 'and even the office ... may occasionally change'. Not supported: the data_fields entry forecast_thi_hourly cites this page for 'update_frequency: several times daily (NWS forecast)', but the page states no forecast update frequency. The integration entry itself correctly says 'not stated'. The page does not state coverage beyond NWS Weather Forecast Office grids (about 2.5 km).
integrations.merged_research_notes: [water integration 0] provides: 7-day 12-hour and hourly forecasts on a 2.5 km grid; station observations; failure: Rate-limit errors (retry after about 5 s). Grid points can change, so re-check /points. Known issue: 24 h max/min null outside Central time. The Great Plains ranch would be in Central or Mountain time. | [health integration 0] provides: 7-day hourly point forecasts (forecastHourly, forecastGridData) used to compute THI for planned handling days; failure: Show 'no forecast available' and leave the day unclassified. A static portfolio demo must not call it live; use a labelled synthetic forecast file.

integrations.verification_note: [cite_grazing.json checked[0], claim partly] Fetched with WebFetch; curl gave 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. Metadata is correct: 'Prescribed Grazing', Range Technical Note No. 9, April 2017, running header 'SOUTH DAKOTA TECHNICAL GUIDE NOTICE SD-424'. VERIFIED: p.4 'Livestock movements should be based on plant growth and utilization and not calendar dates.' and 'Calendar dates may be used as a guide when developing grazing schedules.' p.3 'Keeping the grazing periods as short as practical, especially during periods of fast plant growth, will minimize the opportunity ... to graze plant regrowth prior to plant recovery.' p.3, once-over use ('When two or more pastures are planned to be grazed only one time'): rangeland 'minimum of 45 consecutive days of rest during the growing season', pasture 30. p.3, 2+ grazings ('When two or more pastures are planned to be grazed two or more times during a growing season'): 'Each pasture will be deferred for a minimum of 90 days during the growing season.' The p.4 Table 1 range values match the research: 20-30%* West fast 40, slow 60; East 35/55. 40-50%: West 50/70, East 45/65. Footnote: 'Fast growth usually refers to grasses in a vegetative, pre-boot stage.' Note: 'Under drought conditions, recovery periods may need to be extended to 90 days or longer'. Utilization limits match: 50% seasonal and 30% temporal (p.4), 65% browse and 60% dormant season (p.6). Table 3 (p.6, titled 'Minimum Height of Pasture Species') gives end stubble WWG 4, CWG 3, switchgrass 8, big & sand bluestem 6, KBG 2, sideoats 2, and begin heights WWG 6-10 etc., all as cited. Riparian 'residual heights of 4 to 8 inches is commonly cited as adequate' (Section IV, p.7). App. B p.16: 'Monitor grazing lands frequently and ensure animals have access to dependable water.' Phase I removes 10% in the first month; Phase II removes 20-40% and says 'Routinely monitor conditions such as soil moisture and plant growth on a weekly basis'; Phase III says 'measure remaining forage in all pastures', 'combine remaining herds into one herd', with 30%+ removal on p.16. All verified. MISREAD: the research says '>1 mile to water = very large field needing herding or water relocation'. The source says 'A very large field would roughly be where the distance to water is greater than one mile' ('could be considerably larger on smooth terrain'). Its point is that continuous season-long use gives adequate recovery only on very large fields where livestock are herded or redistributed by changing water. It does not say every field over 1 mile needs herding. The page number for this passage came back inconsistently from two fetches (p.2 and p.3).

integrations.verification_note: [cite_grazing.json checked[5], claim yes] R1780, Meehan, Sedivec, Printz. 'Revised October 2024'; no original date shown, so the research is correct. Table 1 recovery (min days): rangeland fast (May/June) 45 western ND / 30 eastern; slow (July/August) 65 / 45. Introduced pasture 25/15 fast, 35/25 slow. All match. Measure before turnout and during grazing to prevent overuse; 'Final utilization levels should be evaluated within three days of livestock removal.' 'You should take a minimum of 30 measurements for each key species across a pasture.' Avoid water sources, salt sites and gates. Removal % = (1 - grazed/ungrazed) x 100. WWG: 75% height removal is about 58% by weight (Table 3). Table 5 classes: slight-moderate <40, full 40-60, close 60-80, severe >80. Rule of thumb about 50% by weight. Native cool-season reaches 3.5-leaf mid-late May or early June. One extra point the research did not use: the document also suggests targeting about 50% weight use per grazing period, which is looser than SD TN9's 30% temporal limit. The two sources disagree on the per-stay ceiling.

integrations.name: Browser localStorage (Web Storage)
integrations.provides: Per-device persistence of small key/value data
integrations.access: window.localStorage; synchronous; throws SecurityError when blocked or QuotaExceededError when full
integrations.coverage: One browser profile on one device for one origin. http and https are separate stores.
integrations.latency: Immediate on this device; never shared.
integrations.failure_behavior: Cleared when the last private tab closes. Evicted LRU under storage pressure unless persisted. Safari deletes script-created data after 7 days with no interaction (tracking prevention on). The page must render fully with an empty store.
integrations.browser_cors_or_key_issues: Same-origin only; http and https are separate stores. Throws SecurityError when blocked (MDN) and QuotaExceededError when full (WHATWG).
integrations.recommendation: Phase 2: per-device conveniences only (selected filter, last review time, an acknowledgement labelled 'this device only'). Never for shared acknowledgements, owners or shelving. The page must render fully with an empty store.
integrations.verification_note: [cite_workflow.json checked[23], claim partly] Used in the localStorage integration. SecurityError is confirmed. The page names only SecurityError; it does NOT mention QuotaExceededError or full storage, which comes from WHATWG. The LRU-eviction and Safari 7-day points in failure_behavior come from the MDN quotas page, not this URL.

integrations.name: Storage API persistence (navigator.storage.persist)
integrations.provides: Asks the browser to exempt the origin from automatic eviction
integrations.access: navigator.storage.persist() promise; browser may prompt or decide
integrations.failure_behavior: May be denied. The user can still clear data. Does not share data across devices.
integrations.browser_cors_or_key_issues: Same device and origin; the browser may prompt or decide.
integrations.recommendation: Not needed while localStorage holds only conveniences; it does not share data.
integrations.verification_note: [cite_workflow.json checked[24], claim yes] Used in rule 15 and the persist integration. The page reads 'last modified on Jan 5, 2026', which matches. 'In most cases, browsers manage stored data per origin.' It defines best-effort (the default) and persistent storage, and LRU eviction ('The data from the least recently used origin is deleted'). Verbatim: 'Browsers can store up to 5 MiB of local storage, and 5 MiB of session storage per origin' (also 'limited to 10 MiB of data maximum'). Safari: 'If an origin has no user interaction... in the last seven days of browser use, its data created from script will be deleted' when cross-site tracking prevention is on. persist(): Firefox shows a prompt, while Safari and Chromium auto-approve or deny, which supports 'browser may prompt or decide'. When used as the evidence_url for last_review_at, it supports only per-device storage. Calling localStorage 'acceptable' for conveniences is the researcher's judgement.
